purpose: Absorb AI Era agent-reading guidance into RedCap's engineering discipline and long-term memory architecture without bypassing RedCap Forge, identity protection, retrieval thresholds, or public-arsenal safety gates.

absorbed_engineering_principles.redcap_mapping: .dev-task.md confirmed requirements, drift sentinels, and human-facing checkpoint summaries must surface assumptions rather than hide them in chat.
Prefer the smallest policy/checker slice that preserves existing safety gates; do not add a new knowledge layer when a deferred decision record is enough.
Touch only files inside the declared active_slice; unrelated cleanup remains a separate task.
Every absorbed rule must have a validator, acceptance case, closeout evidence, or an explicit manual-only/deferred boundary.

raw_sources.meaning: Immutable or private evidence that can be read for distillation but must not be rewritten as public knowledge.
redcap_paths: external source documents explicitly supplied by the user

wiki_or_synthesis_layer.meaning: LLM-maintained synthesis is allowed only inside existing governed surfaces; RedCap does not introduce an unconstrained LLM-owned wiki layer by default.

schema_layer.meaning: Schema is represented by existing references policies and shared-knowledge schemas; a physically separate schema directory is deferred until scale requires it.

operations.redcap_mapping: RedCap Forge candidate capture, privacy scan, dedupe, structure, index, and promote/no-promote decision.
Read indexes, catalogs, dictionaries, and metadata first; load exact bodies only for precise evidence needs.
Use knowledge index checks, token-risk audit, retrieval escalation checks, Forge checks, shared-knowledge checks, and this alignment checker to detect stale, unsafe, or overclaimed memory surfaces.

immediate_decisions.reason: Kimi challenger identified structural and permission risks; RedCap can absorb index/log/lint concepts without introducing a new owner model.
High-value answers may become Evolution candidates, but must not bypass lessons, identity, Forge, or public-arsenal gates.
llm-wiki supports index-first operation at moderate scale; RedCap already has retrieval escalation thresholds for FTS/RAG/GraphRAG.
Claude reviewer identified a possible future schema-layer split, but current references policies and shared-knowledge schemas are sufficient.
The source is a short learning-coach prompt draft with noisy text; it should be cleaned only if RedCap later builds a learning-planning skill.

must_not_claim: Do not claim RedCap has implemented a complete LLM Wiki system.
Do not claim query answers can directly write public redcap-arsenal entries.
Do not claim this task enables RAG, GraphRAG, or vector search.
Do not claim ai-professor-mode is production-ready or part of RedCap core.
Do not claim raw private reports, identity, or runtime traces are safe public sources.
